name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: Miners learn how to shape raw earth and mineral ore into a lodestone, an essential instrument for anchoring wilderness camps in the wild.
Campcraft relies closely on basic culinary skills, as any viable shelter requires a proper campfire taught by cooking trainers.

faq.answer: A lodestone acts as a foundational tool used by wilderness survivalists to establish and anchor a personal campsite out in the wilds.
faq.q: What is a lodestone used for?

faq.answer: Townspeople and settlement authorities frown upon adventurers pitching tents and setting up camp in public squares or city streets, meaning you must venture out into the wild to establish one.
faq.q: Can I set up camp inside a town or city?

faq.answer: Every camp requires a warm campfire to be considered complete. You cannot properly pitch your camp without one burning nearby.
faq.q: What is required before setting up a camp?

faq.answer: Basic fire-starting is an essential part of the culinary arts, taught readily by cooking instructors and chefs across Azeroth.
faq.q: Where do I learn how to build a campfire?

faq.answer: Miners possess the trade knowledge required to extract and work the natural minerals and stone needed to craft a lodestone.
faq.q: How does mining connect to crafting a lodestone?

faq.answer: You should head past the city gates and out into the open wilderness where there is plenty of open ground and no disapproving townsfolk.
faq.q: Where should I go to test my new camp?

sections.body: Venturing out beyond the safety of guarded roads requires self-reliance and fieldcraft. Miners learn to apply their knowledge of minerals and stone to craft a lodestone, an anchor piece used to pitch a functional campsite out in the untamed world.
sections.title: Fieldcraft for Miners

sections.body: Settled folk take a dim view of travelers pitching shelters in the middle of town squares or bustling thoroughfares. Establishing a campsite demands heading out into the open wilds, away from town limits. Furthermore, no wilderness site is truly functional without a roaring campfire to stave off the night chill, making basic culinary firecraft an indispensable companion to mineral work.
sections.title: Rules of the Wild

summary: Camping 101: Mining instructs miners in crafting a lodestone to establish campsites out in the wilderness. It marks an essential step in survival training, emphasizing the reliance of wild camping on mineral crafting and basic fire-building.
